propositions: The completion verifier pins a stale local mirror of the ticket store instead of the live tracker HEAD, causing it to read outdated ticket state (zero comments, stale status) that contradicts the authoritative store

The verifier's fenced context comes from the live store while show_ticket reads the pinned snapshot, causing the two halves of the gate to disagree and the model to correctly prefer the stale data per documented protocol
A non-PASS verdict with no findable criteria is synthesized with a placeholder (unspecified) rather than reported as a verifier fault, making it indistinguishable from a parse failure
The close path calls materialize_tickets with fetch=False, which skips origin/tickets and pins the main repo's stale local refs/heads/tickets mirror instead of the live .tickets-tracker HEAD

Two independent blocked closes (wailsome-unsure-asianlion, fixable-angular-caribou) both presented different symptoms (false state claims, budget starvation) but traced to the same root cause: invisible comments and events in the stale pinned snapshot
